description: Jogo interativo web baseado no livro-jogo Aventuras Fantásticas 05 — O Calabouço da Morte (Deathtrap Dungeon). Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + Zustand. 100% client-side.

userStories.title: Scaffold Next.js project with TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/ui
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the base project scaffolded so all other tasks have a working foundation.
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js 14+ App Router project created with TypeScript
Tailwind CSS configured and working
shadcn/ui initialized with Button, Card, Dialog components
Zustand installed as dependency
Framer Motion installed as dependency
Project runs with npm run dev without errors
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define TypeScript types for game engine
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all game types defined so the engine and UI can share a common type system.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/engine/types.ts with interfaces: Section, Choice, Combat, Enemy, LuckTest, SkillTest, Character, GameState
Section type supports: id, text, choices, combat, luckTest, skillTest, itemGain, itemLose, staminaChange, skillChange, luckChange, isEnding, isVictory
Choice type supports: text, targetSection, condition (hasItem/hasMinSkill/hasMinLuck)
Character type includes: skillInitial, skillCurrent, staminaInitial, staminaCurrent, luckInitial, luckCurrent, provisions, potion, potionUsed, inventory, currentSection, visitedSections, isAlive
All types exported and importable
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create dice utility module
userStories.description: As a developer, I need dice rolling functions for combat, luck tests, and character creation.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/engine/dice.ts with functions: rollD6(), roll2D6(), rollCharacterSkill() (1d6+6), rollCharacterStamina() (2d6+12), rollCharacterLuck() (1d6+6)
All functions return numeric results
Exported and importable
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create Zustand game store
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a centralized game state store that manages the character, current section, and all game actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/engine/store.ts using Zustand
Store holds full GameState with character, currentSection, gamePhase (menu/create/playing/combat/dead/victory)
Actions: createCharacter(), goToSection(id), addItem(item), removeItem(item), hasItem(item), eatProvision(), usePotion(), updateStats(), resetGame()
localStorage persistence for save/load via Zustand middleware
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Extract and structure first 20 sections from PDF as seed data
userStories.description: As a developer, I need sample section data to build and test the UI against real content.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/data/sections.json with at least sections 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 10, 12, 66, 270, 400 from the book
Each section follows the Section type: id, text (in Portuguese), choices array, optional combat/luckTest/skillTest
Section 1 has choices leading to 270 and 66
Section 400 has isVictory: true
Section 3 has isEnding: true
Section 6 has combat with Mantecora (skill 11, stamina 11)
JSON is valid and parseable
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The PDF is at ~/Downloads/Aventuras_Fantasticas_05_O_Calabouco_da_Morte.pdf. Use pdftotext to extract text and manually structure the sections.

userStories.title: Create section loader utility
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a function to load sections by ID from the JSON data.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/engine/sections.ts with getSection(id: number): Section | undefined
Loads from src/data/sections.json
Returns undefined for nonexistent sections
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build main menu page
userStories.description: As a player, I want a main menu to start a new game or continue a saved one.
acceptanceCriteria: src/app/page.tsx shows game title 'O Calabouço da Morte' with dark medieval theme
Two buttons: 'Nova Aventura' (goes to /create) and 'Continuar' (goes to /game, disabled if no save)
Dark background with atmospheric styling
Responsive on mobile
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Build character creation page
userStories.description: As a player, I want to create my character by rolling dice for attributes and choosing a potion.
acceptanceCriteria: src/app/create/page.tsx with character creation flow
Roll buttons for Habilidade (1d6+6), Energia (2d6+12), Sorte (1d6+6) with animated results
Potion selection: Poção da Habilidade, Poção da Força, Poção da Fortuna (radio/card selection)
Summary showing all stats before confirming
Confirm button creates character in store and navigates to /game
Responsive on mobile

userStories.title: Build game page with StoryPanel and ChoicePanel
userStories.description: As a player, I want to read the story text and make choices to navigate between sections.
acceptanceCriteria: src/app/game/page.tsx displays current section text from store
StoryPanel component renders section narrative text in Portuguese
ChoicePanel component renders available choices as clickable buttons
Clicking a choice calls goToSection() and updates the view
If section has isEnding=true, show 'Sua aventura terminou aqui' with restart option
If section has isVictory=true, show victory screen
Responsive on mobile

userStories.description: As a player, I want to see my current stats (Skill, Stamina, Luck) while playing.
acceptanceCriteria: CharacterSheet component shows: Habilidade (current/max), Energia (current/max), Sorte (current/max), Provisões count
On desktop: fixed sidebar on the right
On mobile: collapsible bottom sheet or slide-out panel
Stats update in real-time as game state changes
Visual indicators when stats are low (red when < 25% of max)

userStories.title: Implement combat engine
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a combat resolution system for the turn-based fights.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/engine/combat.ts with function resolveCombatRound(playerSkill, enemySkill): CombatRoundResult
CombatRoundResult includes: playerRoll, enemyRoll, playerAttack, enemyAttack, winner ('player'|'enemy'|'tie'), damage
Player attack = 2d6 + playerSkill, Enemy attack = 2d6 + enemySkill
Winner deals 2 damage to loser, tie = no damage
Support for luck in combat: lucky hit = 4 damage, unlucky hit = 1 damage
Support for escape (costs 2 stamina)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build CombatPanel UI component
userStories.description: As a player, I want to fight monsters in turn-based combat with dice rolling.
acceptanceCriteria: CombatPanel shows enemy name, skill, and stamina
Attack button rolls dice and shows results for both sides
Health bars for player and enemy that decrease with damage
Option to 'Test Luck' after each hit for bonus/reduced damage
Escape button shown when combat allows escape
Combat ends when either side reaches 0 stamina
Victory navigates to the combat's victorySection
Death triggers game over
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Implement luck and skill test mechanics
userStories.description: As a player, I want to test my luck and skill when the story requires it.
acceptanceCriteria: When section has luckTest, show 'Teste sua Sorte' button
Roll 2d6: if <= current Luck = lucky (go to luckySection), else unlucky (go to unluckySection)
Always subtract 1 from Luck after test
When section has skillTest, show 'Teste sua Habilidade' button
Roll 2d6: if <= current Skill = success, else fail
Show dice roll animation and result before navigating
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Implement inventory system with conditional choices
userStories.description: As a player, I want to collect items and have choices gated by item possession.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory component shows list of carried items
Items are added/removed based on section itemGain/itemLose
Choices with condition.type='hasItem' are only shown if player has the item
Choices with condition.type='hasMinSkill' only shown if player meets threshold
Eat Provision button: consumes 1 provision, restores 4 Stamina (not above max), disabled in combat
Use Potion button: one-time use, restores respective attribute to initial value
Typecheck passes

userStories.description: As a player, I want an atmospheric dark dungeon aesthetic for immersion.
acceptanceCriteria: Dark color scheme with stone/parchment textures via Tailwind
Custom fonts: serif for story text, fantasy-style for headings

userStories.title: Add save/load and game over/victory screens
userStories.description: As a player, I want my progress saved automatically and clear ending screens.

Continue button on main menu loads saved state
